GeometryNodeIndexOfNearest — implicit position, excludes self, returns index of nearest OTHER point
GeometryNodeSampleIndex data_type='FLOAT_VECTOR' — reads vec3 attribute at arbitrary index
GeometryNodeAttributeStatistic data_type='FLOAT_VECTOR' — Mean output gives flock centroid
Speed clamp: ShaderNodeVectorMath NORMALIZE → ShaderNodeMath MIN → ShaderNodeVectorMath SCALE
FunctionNodeAlignEulerToVector axis='Z' — rotates cone Z-axis to face velocity direction
Sequential frame_set(1..N) + view_layer.update() mandatory to build simulation cache headlessly
Marsaglia method for uniform random sphere direction (no trig needed for velocity init)
